mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS month-over-month change > 0.10 percentage points) signals an impending monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, compressing S&P 500 valuations and producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS increased by at least 0.10 percentage points month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of months where UNRATE is above 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL month-over-month change > 3.0%) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS month-over-month change > 0.10 percentage points) trigger a monetary policy response that compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both CPIAUCSL (m/m) > 0.03 and FEDFUNDS (m/m) > 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a month-over-month decline in housing starts exceeding 2% (HOUST m/m < -0.02) signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST (m/m) < -0.02 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS month-over-month change > 0.10%) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of months where PAYEMS increased by at least 0.10% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0 (index, 2017=100), it indicates a manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of months where INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in retail sales (RSAFS month-over-month change < -1.0%) and industrial production (INDPRO month-over-month change < -1.0%) indicates a broad economic slowdown that depresses corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both RSAFS (m/m) < -0.01 and INDPRO (m/m) < -0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS month-over-month change < -0.05 percentage points) signals accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.05 percentage points and the economy is in a post-recession recovery regime.
